subject: Azure co-sell: Partner Center referral owner reconciliation & weekly ops cadence
messages:
From: Microsoft Partner Center <pc-ops@microsoft.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Contoso Seller Ops <contoso-seller-ops@contoso.com>
Date: 2025-05-19T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Referral ownership mismatch for Contoso (Partner Center export attached)

Hi Kimberly,

We ran a reconciliation of Partner Center referral data against the seller assignments you submitted and found a ~12% mismatch for Contoso accounts that are in co-sell intake. The attached workbook (contoso-referrals-mismatch.xlsx) shows the referral IDs and the partner-submitted owner vs. the PC-owner column. A few examples:

- Referral ID 98431: PC-owner shows Azure Field Seller Joel Lang, partner submit shows "Redwood - US West" as owner (no seller email)
- Referral ID 98620: duplicate referral assigned to two different seller IDs

We need to resolve ownership before the co-sell enablement window closes next week. Can your team confirm the mapping logic you use to map partner-submitted accounts to field sellers and provide either: (a) an exported CSV of your PC owner table, or (b) API access/scopes so we can pull the same export?

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm preferred path (CSV export vs API access)
- We schedule a quick sync (30m) with PC intake ops and your seller-ops to triage the top 200 mismatches

Thanks,
Alex Munroe
Partner Center Operations
Microsoft

[Attachment: contoso-referrals-mismatch.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Microsoft Partner Center <pc-ops@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Contoso Seller Ops <contoso-seller-ops@contoso.com>
Date: 2025-05-20T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Referral ownership mismatch for Contoso (Partner Center export attached)

Thanks Alex — and thanks for the workbook. We appreciate the flag.

Short answer: we can provide a canonical export and set up a weekly reconciliation cadence. A few notes on our side so we can align quickly:

- Mapping logic: we run a heuristic that prefers (1) seller consent records tied to partner-submitted contact email, (2) account-to-account match via MPN/tenant IDs, then (3) bucket by region/sales-owner if previous signals are missing. We can share the exact SQL.
- Typical sources of mismatch: partners submitting reseller groups instead of field seller emails, stale seller syncs from older Partner Center imports, and duplicated referrals when partners resubmit.

Immediate ask: I have attached the SQL we use to generate our PC owner extract (redwood-pc-owner-query.sql). If Microsoft wants to pull directly, we can also create a service principal with read-only scope for the partner center referrals export; please share required scopes and the tenant to grant.

Proposed cadence: weekly reconciliation run every Tuesday PST, followed by a 30-minute ops sync on Wednesdays for the first 6 weeks to triage edge cases. Owner: Redwood seller-ops (Ben) + Partner Center intake (Alex).

I’ve included Karthik and Vanessa who will own the mapping rules and rollout changes. If that works, Ben and I will prepare the initial canonical export (pc-owner-export-20250518.csv) and a short triage workback.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Partnerships | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: redwood-pc-owner-query.sql (sql)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Microsoft Partner Center <pc-ops@microsoft.com>, Contoso Seller Ops <contoso-seller-ops@contoso.com>
Date: 2025-05-21T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Referral ownership mismatch for Contoso (Partner Center export attached)

Thanks Kim — quick follow-up with the technical approach from RD side so ops can triage: 

1) Matching priority (to be codified into SQL and a small reconciliation script):
   - Exact tenant ID (highest confidence)
   - Seller consent record linking referral->seller email
   - Partner-submitted account id (MPN/partner account id) mapped to our account fabric
   - Geolocation fallback: map by Contoso regional owner (us-west/us-east/eu) + seller cadence

2) Duplicate referrals: we will run a de-dup pass (same tenant + partner contact + created_at within 48h) and mark lower-confidence referral as candidate for manual review.

3) Data transfer: if Microsoft can accept SFTP drop, we will push the canonical CSV nightly for the first week and then weekly after cadence is stable. If PC wants direct API pulls, scope required: PartnerCenter.Referrals.Read.All (read-only).

4) Triage plan & schedule:
   - Tue 2025-05-27 09:00 PST: initial reconciliation run (top 2,000 referrals)
   - Wed 2025-05-28 10:00 PST: 30m triage with Alex + Ben + Kim + Contoso ops

Ben — can you own the initial CSV drop and confirm you can produce the top-200 mismatch report by Tue morning?

Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

[excerpt: sample matching SQL logic included inline above]

From: Microsoft Partner Center <pc-ops@microsoft.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Contoso Seller Ops <contoso-seller-ops@contoso.com>
Date: 2025-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Referral ownership mismatch for Contoso (Partner Center export attached)

Kimberly — thanks for the fast response and for the SQL. All sounds good. We can accept an SFTP nightly drop for the initial week.

We’ve scheduled the reconciliation run and triage as you proposed:
- Tue 2025-05-27 09:00 PST: Microsoft will ingest the CSV you drop to sftp://pc-ingest.microsoft.com/contoso/ (we will send a short virus-check + manifest validation script)
- Wed 2025-05-28 10:00 PST: 30m triage sync (calendar invite to follow)

Action items for Redwood:
- Ben to post pc-owner-export-20250518.csv to the SFTP by Tue 05/27 06:00 PST (so Microsoft can validate prior to ingestion)
- Kim to confirm service principal details if you prefer API approach later

We’ll share the intake triage agenda and a short list of top-200 referral IDs to focus the first sync. Looking forward to getting this cleaned up — appreciate the quick cadence.

—Alex Munroe
Partner Center Operations
Microsoft
